objective: Ingest September 2026: apply the fills under trades/executed/ since 2026-08-31 to lots/lots.csv, set lots/lots.json current to 2026-09-30, and write reports/2026-09.md in the shape of reports/2026-08.md — the valuation, the time-weighted return over the period's exports, the holdings, and the open items.
contribution: The first unit of the September close. Nothing is judged yet; the lots must simply be what the fills and the custodian say.

fixed.subject: the custodian's exports
fixed.decision: positions/ and prices/ are the custodian's record and are not edited; when the lots and the positions disagree, the lots change.

fixed.subject: trades/executed/
fixed.decision: The record of what was traded is the person's; a unit never writes there. A lot is opened by a fill, at the fill's price, and reduced by the fills that name it.

fixed.subject: open items
fixed.decision: A position the custodian carries that universe.json does not name is listed under Open items with its shares and value; the close does not settle it.

delegated.subject: the account line's wording
delegated.bounds: One or two sentences; the numbers are the custodian's and the return is the time-weighted one over the period's exports.

unresolved.subject: VNQ, 2 shares the custodian's export carries and universe.json does not name
unresolved.reason: Transferred in before the opening purchases; nobody has said what it is or what it cost, and there is no fill to open a lot from.

expectedEvidence.description: run_tests: the portfolio's own suite passes at the committed revision — the lots reconcile to the fills and to the custodian's positions, and the report's return is the positions' time-weighted return
run_checks: the static checks pass and the protected prefixes are untouched
